words.gloss_range: masculine singular relative pronoun that resumes the prior superlative and opens its defining action clause
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) makes 92:18 depend grammatically on the prior title al-atqā in 92:17. The word is definite, masculine, and singular, so it does not begin a loose maxim about anyone at all; it resumes the already named figure and turns the following giving and self-purification into that figure's definition. Because it opens with no coordinating particle, the ayah boundary falls inside a live grammatical dependency: the saved person of 92:17 is immediately unpacked as an acting person in 92:18. The same relative device also answers the negative profile introduced with alladhī in 92:16, so the surah defines both opposite moral types by what they do, not by labels alone.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines the prior title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 92:18 is the behavioral definition of the saved al-atqā from 92:17, not a self-contained maxim.
topics.reason: The QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a masculine singular relative pronoun whose antecedent is the prior masculine singular superlative, and the local clause supplies its verbal content.

topics.headline: relative form opens an action profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the relative word expand a title into a full profile of giving and self-purification.
topics.reason: The pronoun stands before the finite verbs and supplies their shared referent, so the form functions as both connector and identifier.

topics.headline: same relative opening mirrors the negative type
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the positive figure is defined with the same relative-clause mechanism used for the opposite figure in 92:16.
topics.reason: The surah-internal recurrence is locally coherent: 92:16 and 92:18 both begin their moral profile with the same relative pronoun, while their following actions diverge.

topics.headline: boundary moves straight into behavior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah boundary as immediate continuation from promised rescue into the conduct that marks the rescued person.
topics.reason: The ayah begins directly with the relative pronoun rather than a coordinator, and attachment evidence keeps the clause dependent on the preceding antecedent.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect giving as caused arrival or bestowal, with the recipient unexpressed and the owned wealth as explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: coming, bringing, and causing to reach; the local Form IV selects bestowal or causing wealth to arrive, not simple coming
words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْتِى}} ({{tr:yuʾtī}}) begins the behavioral content of the relative clause with an active, imperfect Form IV verb. Its form does more than say that the figure is generous in the abstract: from the arrival root, it casts him as causing his own wealth to reach elsewhere. The explicit object {{ar:مَالَهُۥ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}) keeps the transfer material and costly, while the unnamed recipient leaves attention on the giver, the surrendered wealth, and the self-purifying aim or state. Its imperfect indicative shape makes the act a characterizing habit, not a command or a single past donation. The verb also stands in the familiar Quranic field where giving language meets purification or alms, but here the formula is transformed: the clause moves from {{ar:يُؤْتِى}} ({{tr:yuʾtī}}) to the finite self-purification verb {{ar:يَتَزَكَّىٰ}} ({{tr:yatazakkā}}), so outward transfer and inward transformation answer each other. That directional giving refines the positive path opened by giving in 92:5 and belongs with righteousness scenes where wealth-giving is named (2:177; 76:8-9), while the next ayah denies any payback motive (92:19). Even in sound, the clipped hamza onset of {{ar:يُؤْتِى}} ({{tr:yuʾtī}}) separates the transfer act before the smoother possessed-wealth phrase.

topics.headline: Form IV makes wealth reach elsewhere
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb pictures giving as active caused arrival of owned wealth, not vague benevolence.
topics.reason: QAC and verb-instance evidence identify a Form IV active imperfect with an explicit object, while the local frame leaves any recipient unexpressed.

topics.headline: imperfect indicative marks a defining habit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears giving as the ongoing trait by which al-atqā is recognized, not as an isolated report or instruction.
topics.reason: The verb is finite imperfect indicative, with its subject supplied through the relative pronoun; no local evidence makes it imperative, jussive, conditional, or passive.

topics.headline: giving formula becomes self-purification sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar giving-and-purification field, while the local wording turns it into a sequence of giving wealth and purifying oneself.
topics.reason: The cooccurrence claim is coherent and reinforced by the local adjacency to {{ar:يَتَزَكَّىٰ}} ({{tr:yatazakkā}}), but it must be narrowed because the local construction does not say the noun zakah as an object; it uses a finite self-purification verb.

topics.headline: giving sits in a wider righteousness frame

topics.reason: The references are concrete and do not control the local parse; they supply comparison for the positive path and for the righteous-giving register.

topics.headline: rescued figure becomes active giver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the person kept from fire in 92:17 become the agent of social-material action in 92:18, before 92:19 denies repayment as the motive.
topics.reason: The same cross-ayah referent is subject of the active verb, and the concrete follow-on reference to 92:19 supports the structural pairing without changing the local syntax.

topics.headline: clipped verb sound precedes flowing object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the transfer verb as a clipped onset before the smoother possessed-wealth phrase.
topics.reason: The sound observation is locally anchored in the surface form, though it remains secondary to the grammatical and lexical topics.

words.prose: {{ar:مَالَهُۥ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}) is the explicit object of {{ar:يُؤْتِى}} ({{tr:yuʾtī}}): the clause names the thing transferred, not merely the virtue of giving. The attached possessive suffix makes the cost personal, binding the wealth to the same figure resumed by {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) before the verb hands it away. Its singular form gathers the owned value as his wealth rather than a detached list of assets or communal funds. Lexically, the local root alignment and V4 evidence keep the main sense in wealth and property, while the reported inclination derivation can still color the act as surrendering what the self leans toward. Structurally the word sits between transfer and purification, so the possessed object becomes the hinge: what is attached to him is moved outward and becomes the threshold for {{ar:يَتَزَكَّىٰ}} ({{tr:yatazakkā}}). The sound follows that movement too: the possessive hū keeps the wealth close before the clause opens into the final ā of {{ar:يَتَزَكَّىٰ}} ({{tr:yatazakkā}}). The surah-internal echo sharpens the hinge, because wealth that cannot avail when retained in 92:11 becomes defining when surrendered in 92:18; the person kept away from fire is marked by moving wealth away from himself.

topics.headline: owned wealth is the object given
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act costs the giver his own possessed wealth, not an abstract resource or delegated fund.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the noun the direct object of the giving verb and the suffix the genitive possessor resolving to the same masculine singular subject.

topics.headline: singular possession gathers the cost
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wealth as one personally possessed value being surrendered, not as a generic category of charity.
topics.reason: The noun appears as a singular possessed surface word with the possessor built into the same written form.

topics.headline: wealth sense carries qualified desire pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the gift as surrender of transferable property and, by qualified derivational pressure, of what the self inclines toward.
topics.reason: The local alignment is to {{ar:م و ل}} ({{tr:m-w-l}}) and V4 supports the wealth/property branch, so the alternative inclination derivation is retained only as a meaning-bearing historical pressure, not as the selected local root.

topics.headline: wealth mediates outward gift and inward change
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the word's middle position: the wealth leaves through giving and immediately opens into self-purification.
topics.reason: The object stands between the governing giving verb and the following circumstantial or purposive self-purification verb.

topics.headline: same-surah wealth echo reverses function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a surah-level antithesis: wealth fails as a hoped-for support in 92:11 but defines the saved figure when given in 92:18.
topics.reason: The same wealth root and possessive profile recur within the surah, but syntax reverses the role from failed subject-like support in 92:11 to surrendered object in 92:18.

topics.headline: suffix sound moves toward release
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the possessive suffix hold the wealth close before the clause opens into the final self-purification verb.
topics.reason: The sound observation follows the local surface sequence from possessed wealth to the following final verb, and it remains secondary to the grammatical hinge.

topics.headline: promise becomes material practice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees future rescue grounded in a concrete practice: wealth is moved away from the self.
topics.reason: The cross-boundary relation is coherent because the same referent moves from promised distancing from fire in 92:17 to voluntarily distancing wealth from himself in 92:18.

words.gloss_range: self-purifies, cultivates himself, or grows through purification; locally a finite Form V verb describing state or purpose with the same subject as the giver
words.root_gloss_range: growth, increase, purity, rectitude, and the alms-purification field; local Form V selects self-directed purification/growth, not the noun zakah or unrelated branches such as fittingness or evenness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the giving verb whose action is interpreted by the final verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَتَزَكَّىٰ}} ({{tr:yatazakkā}}) closes the ayah by interpreting the gift just named. As a finite imperfect, it presents self-purification as an ongoing orientation, and because there is no overt purposive particle it can be heard both as the state accompanying the gift and as the aim for which the gift is made. The subject is not renamed: the same figure who gives {{ar:مَالَهُۥ}} ({{tr:mālahū}}) is the one being purified. Form V makes that inward return visible, with the subject acting upon himself rather than an external object being purified. The root field fuses cleansing with growth, so the final verb does not reduce the scene to a payment category; it describes a self-cultivating transformation in which surrender of wealth works like pruning, removing what clings while enabling growth. That is why the echo of the common giving-and-zakah field is real but transformed: the ayah chooses a finite self-purification verb rather than a noun for alms. The word also joins other self-purification salvation scenes (79:18; 87:14; 35:18), and within this surah it links the positive path of giving and guarding (92:5) to the title defined in 92:17. In final position, the heavier doubled sound and denser t-z-k-k texture make inward purification feel weightier than the outward transfer that initiates it.

topics.headline: finite imperfect leaves state and purpose live
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that self-purification is ongoing and can describe both how he gives and why he gives.
topics.reason: QAC marks a finite imperfect verb, and attachment evidence licenses the verb as a circumstantial state or aim accompanying the giving clause rather than a separate sequential action.

topics.headline: giver is also self-purifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees outward giving return inwardly upon the same subject as self-purification.
topics.reason: The verb is Form V, intransitive in the local frame, and shares its understood subject with the relative pronoun and the giving verb.

topics.headline: purification and growth converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final verb as cleansing that also cultivates growth, especially after wealth has just been surrendered.
topics.reason: V4 supports accepted branches for growth and for purity or rectitude, and the local self-directed verb after wealth-giving lets both pressures remain productive.

topics.headline: zakah field becomes a self-process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader catches the giving-and-zakah resonance while seeing that the ayah names the giver's self-purification, not an alms noun as object.
topics.reason: The collocation background is supported, but the local surface is a finite verb with no expressed object, so the topic must be narrowed away from reading the word as the noun zakah itself.

topics.headline: final verb joins salvation purification scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can place the verb beside other self-purification salvation contexts (79:18; 87:14; 35:18) without letting those contexts override this local clause.
topics.reason: The cited parallels use the same self-purification field and are concrete enough to retain as comparison, while local syntax still governs the reading.

topics.headline: final verb explains the gift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word gives the preceding wealth-transfer its moral and inward meaning.
topics.reason: The verb follows the giving-and-wealth phrase as the final isolated beat, and attachment evidence connects it as state or aim rather than an unrelated action.

topics.headline: taqwa opens into self-cultivation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the positive path of giving, guarding, and self-purification joined across 92:5, 92:17, and 92:18.
topics.reason: The surah links giving and guarding in 92:5, names the most guarded figure in 92:17, and defines him with self-purification in 92:18.

topics.headline: gemination gives the ending weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the doubled consonant give the final self-purification verb an effortful weight.
topics.reason: The surface form contains the doubled consonantal base associated with the Form V reflexive, so the sound topic is locally anchored but secondary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence يُؤْتِي مَالَهُ يَتَزَكَّىٰ joins an outward transfer of what is his to an inward reflexive change.
baseline_models.mechanism: Possessed wealth is deliberately granted away, and the reflexive final verb makes the release act back upon the giver as purification and rectification.

activation_trace.role: The granting-and-giving branch supplies the outward transfer that initiates the mechanism.
The acquisition-and-possession branch marks the object as wealth held as one's own and therefore genuinely relinquished.
The purity-and-rectitude branch supplies the reflexive inward result of the outward gift.

changed_reading.before: A person simply parts with some property.
changed_reading.after: The person transfers owned wealth in a way that recursively cleans and rectifies the giver.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The giving verb and يَتَزَكَّىٰ both carry branches of yield, increase, and growth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The apparent subtraction of wealth is recoded as productive release: what leaves possession becomes yield, while the giver enters a process of growth rather than mere depletion.

activation_trace.role: The yield-and-produced-increase branch makes the act of giving capable of being imaged as releasing a return or crop.
The wealth-possession branch supplies the stock whose reduction would ordinarily look like loss.
The growth-and-increase branch turns relinquishment into the giver's productive enlargement.

changed_reading.before: Giving diminishes the giver's available wealth.
changed_reading.after: Giving is a release whose paradoxical product is increase and growth in the giver.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of يُؤْتِي includes a watercourse and cleared-flow image beside the explicit wealth and growth sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Wealth can be carried as a moving medium rather than a static hoard: giving clears or directs its course, and unobstructed circulation permits growth.

activation_trace.role: The watercourse-and-cleared-flow branch supplies the material image of routing wealth through rather than retaining it.
The possession branch supplies what can either pool as stock or be put into circulation.
The growth branch supplies the flourishing made possible by the reopened course.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is a quantity from which a gift is removed.
changed_reading.after: Wealth is a current whose deliberate routing through the giver opens a channel of growth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence can join bringing a matter through its proper access to an act that fits or befits its agent.
baseline_models.mechanism: The giver does not merely surrender an amount; the giver finds the proper outlet for wealth, and this apt handling makes the act congruent with the person the giver is becoming.

activation_trace.role: The proper-access, tact, and readiness branch supplies an apt way of bringing the wealth to its destination.
The possession branch makes wealth the entrusted material whose outlet must be found.
The suitability-and-fittingness branch makes the resulting act something that befits and reshapes the giver.

changed_reading.before: Purification follows from losing an amount of money.
changed_reading.after: Purification also lies in finding wealth's fitting outlet and becoming congruent with that rightly routed act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening alternation between covering and disclosure makes the gift readable across two visibility regimes. Its purifying force need not be produced by social display; the same transfer can remain operative when covered and when manifest.

activation_trace.role: The giving branch anchors the visibility experiment in the actual transfer named by the focus ayah.
The purification branch supplies an inward effect that can persist independently of whether the act is seen.
The covering branch supplies concealment as one environmental regime for the giving.
The disclosure-and-appearance branch supplies the opposite regime in which the same act becomes visible.

structural_cues: The surah opens with night covering and day disclosing, while the focus clause itself gives no publicity marker.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alternating cover and disclosure; I apply that alternation to the social visibility of the anchored gift. A live alternative is that the opening contrast remains purely cosmic and does not specify how the gift is witnessed.

changed_reading.before: The verse depicts a gift without asking how visibility affects it.
changed_reading.after: The verse can depict an act whose inward efficacy survives both concealment and manifestation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divergent striving turns giving into a route-selecting practice rather than an isolated donation. The nearby coupling of handing over with self-protection lets the focus act be read as a repeated outward maneuver that also places the self within a guard.

activation_trace.role: The granting branch supplies the concrete act by which a route is chosen.
The rectification branch makes the chosen route transformative of the actor.
The purposeful-motion branch frames conduct as directed movement toward a sought destination.
The dispersion branch supplies genuinely diverging courses rather than interchangeable good deeds.
The handing-over branch closely echoes the focus transfer and locates it in the selected course.
The self-in-protection branch supplies the reflexive protective function paired with giving.

structural_cues: The declaration that strivings diverge is immediately followed by the giving/protection sequence and its withholding counterpart.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directed striving, divergence, handing over, and self-protection; I infer a functional arrow from repeated giving to a protected and rectified course. The live alternative is that protection is an independent virtue merely conjoined with giving.

changed_reading.before: The focus gift is one commendable act among others.
changed_reading.after: The gift is a route-selecting practice through which the giver repeatedly enters a protective, self-rectifying course.

context_deltas.mechanism: Giving wealth becomes a material verification of what the giver affirms as good. The transfer moves truth from speech or assent into fulfilled action, with the wealth serving as the matter in which the claim is tested.

activation_trace.role: The granting branch supplies the performed act that can verify a prior affirmation.
The possession branch supplies costly material evidence rather than a costless verbal claim.
The fulfillment-in-action branch turns affirmation into realized conduct.
The wealth-and-right charity branch binds truthful realization specifically to material giving.
The enacted-good branch supplies the quality that the transfer embodies rather than merely names.

structural_cues: Affirming the good precedes facilitation, while denial precedes the opposed facilitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affirmation, fulfillment in action, material charity, and enacted good; I infer that the focus transfer functions as evidence that makes the affirmation true in practice. A live alternative confines the affirmation to belief and treats giving as a separate consequence.

changed_reading.after: Giving one's own wealth is the material event that verifies and realizes the claimed good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's watercourse and growth images become dynamic under the paired facilitation scenes. Giving clears a course and makes movement increasingly light and productive; the opposed course bends into obstruction and difficulty.

activation_trace.role: The cleared-watercourse branch supplies the focus-level channel whose condition can change through use.
The growth branch supplies the productive consequence of an opened course.
The opening-and-ease-after-hardship branch supplies a corridor that becomes passable.
The milk-yield and growth branch reinforces the surprising link between ease, flow, and productive increase.
The twisting-and-obstruction branch supplies the opposed corridor produced by resistance.

structural_cues: The repeated facilitation formula sends opposed agents toward ease and hardship, suggesting trajectories that become easier to continue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cleared course, growth, opening, yield, and opposed twisting; I infer that repeated release conditions a behavioral corridor. The hydraulic and habituation arrows are reader-supplied analogies; the live alternative is moral facilitation without any flow mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The gift is a completed one-time subtraction.
changed_reading.after: The gift reopens a course and trains the giver into an increasingly passable, productive trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Withholding attempts to convert possessed wealth into independence, but the same wealth fails at the moment of collapse. The focus gift therefore purifies not merely by losing an object but by loosening the giver's false identification of possession with self-sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: The giving branch supplies the counter-movement to withholding.
The possession branch supplies the wealth around which a false independent self can be organized.
The purification branch becomes removal of a possessive self-relation, not only accumulation of merit.
The withholding branch supplies the opposed act of closing possession upon oneself.
The self-sufficiency branch supplies the claim that retained wealth can make the holder independent.
The repeated wealth-possession branch brings the focus object into the scene of its failure.
The sufficiency-and-availing branch is explicitly negated, exposing possession's inability to substitute for the self.
The falling-into-ruin branch supplies the limiting event at which retained wealth cannot avail.

structural_cues: The withholding/self-sufficiency pair is followed by the question of wealth's failure when its holder falls.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, claimed self-sufficiency, repeated wealth, non-availing, and collapse; I infer that purification removes dependence on the possessive identity those elements form. A live alternative reads the contrast only as future utility versus non-utility of wealth.

changed_reading.before: Purification is moral credit gained by donating an asset.
changed_reading.after: Purification is also de-possession of the fantasy that owned wealth can constitute or secure an independent self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of approaching by a proper access expands into a guided trajectory with an end or outcome. Giving is not only fitting at the point of transfer; it is entry onto a directed course whose terminus exceeds the possessor.

activation_trace.role: The proper-access branch supplies the apt entry into the trajectory.
The road, junction, and far-limit branch extends giving from an access point into a traveled course and endpoint.
The gentle direction-to-the-way branch supplies guidance along the course.
The return-to-outcome branch supplies a terminus toward which the fitting gift can be read as moving.

structural_cues: Guidance is asserted before first and last are placed beyond human possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proper access, road and limit, gentle direction, and return to outcome; I infer a single trajectory through them. The live alternative is that guidance and temporal sovereignty provide theology around the gift without specifying its internal mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The giver finds an appropriate recipient or outlet.
changed_reading.after: The fitting transfer is an entry into a guided course oriented toward an outcome the giver does not own.

context_deltas.mechanism: The one kept to the side away from the fire is immediately characterized by giving wealth to become purified. This makes giving an embodied alignment with protective separation, while stopping short of treating the gift as a payment that purchases escape.

activation_trace.role: The granting branch supplies the behavior by which the protected figure is characterized.
The purification branch supplies the inward alignment associated with being kept apart from harm.
The distancing-and-keeping-apart branch supplies separation from the preceding danger.
The side-shield branch gives the separation a concrete protective image.
The warding-off-harm branch identifies the figure whose conduct the focus relative clause unfolds.

structural_cues: Ayah 18's relative clause directly continues the protected figure named in ayah 17 after the fire sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passive separation, protective wariness, and the continuing giver-description; I infer that giving manifests the alignment under which separation occurs. The live alternative is evidential rather than causal: the gift identifies the person but does not itself produce protection.

changed_reading.before: A donation earns escape as though paying a price.
changed_reading.after: Giving manifests and cultivates the purified alignment of a person being kept apart from harm, without becoming a purchase.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following negation removes a backward-facing human claim: no one's prior favor is held with the giver as a debt to be repaid. The focus transfer is therefore not settlement of an exchange ledger but an initiating release without a human counterclaim.

activation_trace.role: The granting branch supplies the outward transfer whose transactional status is being tested.
The possession branch makes the transfer a real release of what stood within the giver's holdings.
The purification branch locates the return within transformation of the giver rather than repayment by another person.
The exhaustive-negation branch removes every human creditor from the stated motive.
The near-presence and holding-at branch supplies the image of an obligation standing on someone's account with the giver.
The favor-and-good-condition branch supplies the possible prior benefit that the negation excludes.
The recompense branch supplies the exchange relation explicitly denied as the gift's backward cause.
The debt-collection branch sharpens the excluded model of giving as settling an account.

structural_cues: The negated favor-to-be-recompensed clause follows the focus gift immediately and narrows its motive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive negation, a favor held near, recompense, and debt collection; I infer a human social ledger and its cancellation as explanatory structure. A live alternative is the narrower claim that only one specific prior favor is denied.

changed_reading.before: The giver may be returning a benefit and closing a reciprocal account.
changed_reading.after: The giver initiates a one-way release whose purification depends partly on freedom from human repayment claims.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah gives the release a vector: seeking, direction or face, nurturing completion, growth, and height converge. The focus growth is not self-enlargement or replenishment of one's holdings; it is growth produced by orienting possession beyond the self toward a higher, nurturing end.

activation_trace.role: The granting branch supplies the outward movement that receives a direction.
The increase branch supplies growth whose kind and destination the context revises.
The purity branch keeps the growth ethical and reflexive rather than merely quantitative.
The seeking branch supplies deliberate pursuit as the gift's forward motive.
The direction-and-orientation branch gives the transfer a vector beyond the giver.
The face-as-self branch makes that vector personal rather than an abstract upward motion.
The nurturing, repairing, and completing branch supplies the agency toward which the giver's growth is oriented.
The non-dominant mapped growth-and-nourishment branch unexpectedly resonates with the focus increase and makes growth received rather than self-produced.
The height-and-elevation branch supplies the upward scale of the sought end.

structural_cues: The exclusive seeking clause follows the denial of human recompense and names a higher orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeking, direction, face, nurturing completion, a non-dominant nourishment/growth mapping, and height; I infer that these form the vector and source of the focus growth. The live alternative is a motive clarification with no claim about how purification grows.

changed_reading.before: The giver grows by accumulating moral gain after a loss.
changed_reading.after: The giver grows by reorienting possession away from self-enlargement toward a personal, nurturing, higher end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The future satisfaction closes the sequence without restoring the human exchange ledger. What looks like immediate depletion opens into acceptance or deep contentment, so purification need not be imagined as permanent self-denial.

activation_trace.role: The granting branch supplies the initial release whose eventual affective horizon is disclosed.
The growth branch allows the apparent loss to mature into fullness rather than remain deprivation.
The satisfaction-opposed-to-displeasure branch supplies the eventual settled condition.
The abundant-or-sought satisfaction branch gives the ending a fullness proportionate to the earlier release.

structural_cues: The future marker delays satisfaction until after giving, denial of repayment, and exclusive orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies future satisfaction after a non-reciprocal gift sequence; I infer that satisfaction is the maturation of release rather than its price. The live alternative is simply a promised result with no account of its relation to the gift's inner mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Purifying generosity is an immediate loss accepted through self-denial.
changed_reading.after: Nontransactional release can mature into settled acceptance and contentment without reversing into repayment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The torrent and outsider branches are form-distant and must not be presented as direct glosses of يُؤْتِي. They remain anchored in that focus root and cohere with wealth and growth, while the context supplies separation; downstream prose should mark this as a material-social analogy in which abundance crosses a boundary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus giving root carries both a torrent arriving from a rain-struck place and an outsider entering another people, beside wealth and growth.

activation_trace.role: The elsewhere-arriving torrent branch supplies abundance moving from a supplied region into one that did not receive rain.
The outsider-among-another-people branch turns the transfer into movement across a social boundary.
The wealth branch supplies the abundance capable of crossing that boundary.
The growth branch supplies flourishing on the far side of transfer and in the giver.
The separation, estrangement, and keeping-apart branch supplies the boundary that the torrent-outsider image crosses.

changed_reading.before: A giver transfers an abstract quantity to an unspecified recipient.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, giving is abundance crossing from the socially or materially supplied side toward an outside, dry, or separated side, with growth generated by the crossing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The even-pair branch of the focus purification root is remote from the verbal form and should never replace its ordinary purity or growth senses. It remains useful as a structural activation because the context first supplies a male-female pair and later negates recompense; downstream prose should call this a relational image, not a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's reflexive purification root includes a pair-or-even branch that can make giver and receiver a two-term relation.

activation_trace.role: The giving branch supplies the event that places two human positions into relation.
The pair-and-even branch supplies the surprising two-term structure without deciding that the terms are equal.
The male-in-contrast-to-female branch supplies one side of an explicitly created pair.
The female-in-contrast-to-male branch supplies the complementary side of that pair.
The negated recompense branch prevents the giver-receiver pair from collapsing into balanced quid pro quo.

changed_reading.before: Self-purification is a solitary inward achievement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, purification happens by entering a two-term relation through giving while refusing to reduce that relation to equal exchange.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reported spider term under the wealth root and the non-dominant cutting map under recompense are both highly branch-distant. Their conjunction is nevertheless packet-licensed and focus-anchored; downstream prose should present only a contained metaphor of wealth as an entangling web whose repayment strands are cut, never claim that مَال literally means a web here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus wealth root contains a reported spider term, allowing possessed wealth to be imaged as a web of attachments around the giver.

activation_trace.role: The granting branch supplies the motion by which the giver passes out of an entangling possession.
The reported spider branch supplies the strange but explicit image of wealth as a web of attachments.
The purification branch supplies release from entanglement as the effect on the giver.
The debt-collection branch supplies the social claims that would otherwise form the web's strands.
The non-dominant cutting branch supplies the surprising severing of the repayment strands.

changed_reading.before: Wealth is a neutral object that the owner can either keep or give.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, wealth is also a web of possessive and reciprocal claims, and giving without repayment cuts strands that bind the giver.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The levy branch belongs to the giving root but is not the normal sense of the focus verb. It remains valuable because the next ayat exclude a human creditor and add exclusive seeking; downstream prose should frame this as an inversion of a payment-like exterior, not as a claim that the gift is tax, tribute, or bribe.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: One focus branch images an imposed payment, while the immediate context removes human repayment and supplies a freely sought orientation.

activation_trace.role: The imposed-levy branch supplies the outwardly payment-like form that the context can invert.
The wealth branch supplies the material that could superficially resemble a levy.
The purification branch relocates the act's effect within the giver rather than in compliance with a collector.
The exhaustive-negation branch removes any human claimant who could impose the payment.
The financial-payment branch supplies the transactional model that the negated clause disallows.
The seeking branch replaces imposed extraction with a deliberately pursued end.
The direction branch supplies the freely chosen orientation of the now de-coerced transfer.

changed_reading.before: The outward transfer could be imagined as compliance with an obligation imposed by a claimant.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the payment-like exterior is inverted: with no human collector or debt, the wealth is freely released toward a chosen higher direction.

strongest_changes: The gift became a route-selecting and protective practice rather than an isolated meritorious transfer.
Purification became de-possession of the fantasy that retained wealth creates self-sufficiency.
The following negation removed human repayment and recast giving as release from the exchange ledger.
Seeking, face, nurturing growth, and height redirected increase away from self-enlargement toward a higher personal end.
The focus-only flow image survived context and became an exploratory model of giving as a cleared, increasingly passable corridor.
summary.what_was_special: The packet kept several readings genuinely co-present: ordinary reflexive purification, paradoxical growth through release, truthful enactment, protective route selection, and freedom from reciprocal debt. Its most generative surprises came from branch interactions that a conservative synthesis would likely suppress: watercourse plus facilitation, the non-dominant nourishment mapping under ر ب ب, the non-dominant cutting mapping under ج ز ي, and the torrent, pair, spider, and levy images.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus syntax supports both purpose and unfolding state for يَتَزَكَّىٰ; context strengthens both purification and growth without forcing one to eliminate the other.
The causal strength of giving remains open: it may produce protection and facilitation, enact an already formed alignment, or do both recursively.
The flow, pair, spider, torrent, and levy readings are coherent branch-activated analogies but remain too form-distant to serve as direct lexical renderings.
The final satisfaction can be read as the maturation of nontransactional release, but the packet does not by itself specify every step in that affective transformation.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Giving wealth as purification/growth.** Evidence: `ء ت ي` B002 (granting/giving), `م و ل` B001 (wealth/property), `ز ك و` B002 (purity/rectitude), B001 (growth/increase). Structural cue: this explains the “most guarded” by returning to 92:5’s giving. Mechanism: wealth leaves the hand and the self grows cleaner, reversing hoarding’s sterility. Abductive move: I infer that loss of property can increase the person. Reading change: giving is a purification technology, not merely charity.

2. **Coming through the proper access.** Evidence: `ء ت ي` B003 (approaching a matter through its proper way), activated by `ه د ي` B002 course/direction and `و ج ه` B008 proper aspect in 92:20. Structural cue: the giving sits before explicit seeking of the Lord’s face. Mechanism: wealth is approached through its right face: as a thing to send, not worship. Abductive move: I infer that purification depends on using the correct access-point of مال. Reading change: يؤتي ماله means he handles wealth according to its proper route.

3. **Yield and produced increase.** Evidence: `ء ت ي` B007 (yield/increase), `ز ك و` B001, activated by fertile/generative branches in 92:3. Structural cue: giving precedes رضى in 92:21. Mechanism: outgoing wealth becomes like crop-yield that returns as purified increase. Abductive move: I infer an agricultural cycle from repeated growth/fertility branches. Reading change: giving is harvest-like production, not depletion.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 92:11 confirmed the irony built into `استغنى`: the root returns as “will not avail,” so the claimed sufficiency is exposed by the very verb-family it trusted. 92:19 added a second negation of sufficing: no human favor stands behind the purified giver.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Material decrease becomes productive increase.** `يُؤْتِى` directly anchors `ء ت ي:B002` (granting and giving), `مَالَهُ` anchors `م و ل:B001` (possessed wealth), and `يَتَزَكَّىٰ` activates `ز ك و:B001` (growth and increase). The same `ء ت ي` inventory also contains `ء ت ي:B007` (yield and produced increase), which the growth verb makes newly visible. The packet gives giving followed by growth; the inferred arrow is that outward transfer becomes productive rather than depleting the giver. The ayah therefore reverses ordinary accounting: wealth leaves, yet the acting self is the locus of increase.

2. **Purification targets the motive as well as the possession.** `يَتَزَكَّىٰ` also anchors `ز ك و:B002` (purity and rectitude). The following negation of any favor awaiting repayment in 92:19 and the exclusive seeking in 92:20 strip away a human exchange motive. The packet supplies those exclusions; the abductive move is that they identify what the reflexive purification removes—debt-driven or status-driven contamination of giving. The fixed clause reads as self-purification through a transfer whose purpose is progressively clarified, not merely as cleansing the money itself.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temizlik, düzgünlük ve sakınmayı aynı ahlaki çekirdekte birleştirir; birini düzeltip arındırma, iç temizliği ve dinen uygun olup kötü sonuç doğurmayan yiyecek bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı açılımlarıdır. Mali payın temizleyici sayılması burada yalnız anlam ilişkisini açıklar; mali uygulamanın kendisi ayrı dalda tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal ahlaki ve manevi temizlik ile düzgünlüğü kapsar; yalın büyüme ve maldan ödenen zorunlu pay kendi dallarına aittir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın temizlik ve düzgünlük anlamı; kişiyi düzeltme, iç dünya, kendini övme ve yiyeceğin uygunluğu gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlarla karıştırılmadan sunulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin veya iç durumun kusurdan arınıp ahlaken temiz, doğru ve sakınan bir niteliğe kavuşması ya da bir başkasının onu bu duruma getirmesidir. Yiyecek bağlamında dinen izin verilen ve sonu zarar getirmeyen olmayı da anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, ahlaki veya manevi bakımdan temiz ve düzgün durumda olmaktır.
Bir kişinin bu niteliği taşıması, doğru davranan ve kötülükten sakınan biri olmasıyla belirginleşir.
Anlam, bir kişiyi veya iç dünyayı arındırıp düzeltme ve iyiliklerle geliştirme eylemine uzanır.
Yiyecek için kullanıldığında dinen izin verilen, iyi ve sonradan zarar doğurmayan seçeneği belirtir.
Maldan verilen zorunlu payın temizleyici sayılması, bu ahlaki temizlik alanıyla kurulan açıklayıcı bir bağlantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım temizlik ve düzgünlüğü, kişinin sakınan niteliğini, birini düzeltip arındırmayı ve iç temizliğini birleştirir; yiyeceğin dinen uygun ve sonucu iyi olması da bağlama bağlı bir açılımdır.

Dal bu nedenle salt ahlaki temizlik olarak değil, malın belirli bir bölümünü hak sahibine çıkarma ve verme uygulaması olarak tanımlanmalıdır.

Maldan karşılıksız yardımda bulunmak, zorunlu payla aynı verme alanında yer alan daha genel bir kullanımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü çift veya iki öğeden oluşan taraf için açıkça tanımlar ve onu tek olanın karşısına koyar. Avuçta saklanan şey üzerine sorulan tek-çift sorusu ile buna eşlik eden söyleyiş, aynı karşıtlığın oyun ve tahmin bağlamındaki özel kullanımlarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal çift ve tek karşıtlığıyla sınırlıdır; büyüme, arınma, mali pay ve uygunluk anlamlarıyla birleştirilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çift olmayı adlandıran biçim ile tek-çift karşıtlığını kuran sözler ve avuçtaki şey üzerine söylenen oyun yapıları ayrı kapsamlarıyla korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin tek değil, iki öğeli veya çift sayıda olduğunu bildiren anlamdır. Tek-çift karşıtlığını kuran sözlerde ve avuçta saklanan bir şeyin tek mi çift mi olduğunu tahmin etme oyununda özel olarak kullanılır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, tek olanın karşıtı olarak çift veya iki öğeli olma durumudur.
Sabit karşılaştırma sözünde tek ve çift seçenekleri birbirine karşı konur.
Avuçta saklanan bir şeyin tek mi çift mi olduğunu sorma ve tahmin etme, karşıtlığın oyun içindeki kullanımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı çift veya iki öğeli olmayı tek olanın karşısına koyar; tek-çift sözü ve avuçtaki şey üzerine yapılan tahmin bu karşıtlığın özel kullanımlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin tek değil, iki öğeli veya çift sayıda olduğunu bildiren genel karşılıktır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki seçeneği karşılaştıran sözde veya avuçta saklanan şeyin sayısını tahmin etme oyununda kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sayısal tek-çift karşıtlığına açıktır; komşu dal ise benzer, karşıt veya tamamlayıcı iki öğenin birbirine eşlik etmesini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bire bir ekleyerek iki oluşturma, ikinci olma veya bir şeyi ikileme işlemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal iki öğe ve iki sayısı çevresinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak bir sınıflandırma ve durumdur; komşu ise bir öğeye ikincisini katıp iki oluşturma sürecidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, tek olanın karşıtı olarak çiftliği ve tahmin oyunundaki seçeneği bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, iki varlığın ikisini birden kapsayan dil bilgisel ifadeleri ve onların kullanım kurallarını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da tam olarak iki öğenin birlikte düşünülmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal çift olma niteliğini verir; komşu dal ise adı anılan iki öğeyi eksiksiz kapsayan dil bilgisel araçları konu edinir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, herhangi bir şeyin çift veya çift sayıda olmasını genel biçimde bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, kültürel kullanımda birlikte anılan belirli ikililere verilen ortak bir adı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal iki öğenin tek bir ikili olarak anılması alanına girer.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak genel ve sayısal bir sınıftır; komşu ise su ile yiyecek veya iki zaman dilimi gibi önceden belirlenmiş ikililerin özel adlandırılmasıdır.
